prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough independent, comparable review data here to name one definitive “best.” **Integrity Land Title** is a reasonable West Palm Beach option to contact: it has a local office at **2101 Vista Parkway, Suite 130**, and says it handles title searches, closing documents, escrow, and lien payoffs. It also advertises an average 72-hour turnaround for standard title searches—but that’s the company’s own claim, not an independent performance rating.

Before choosing, ask for a written estimate of all title and closing fees, who will handle your file, expected turnaround, and whether they can accommodate your preferred signing arrangements. Verify the agency’s current Florida license through the state’s license search, and compare at least one other local quote. Your purchase contract may also specify who selects the title company, so check that first.
